Text: O that I had him, With six Aufidiuses, or more, his tribe, To use my lawful sword!
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Well you deserve: they well deserve to have, That know the strong'st and surest way to get. Uncle, give me your hands: nay, dry your eyes; Tears show their love, but want their remedies. Cousin, I am too young to be your father, Though you are old enough to be my heir. What you will have, I'll give, and willing too; For do we must what force will have us do. Set on towards London, cousin, is it so?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: For 'tis a sore upon us, You cannot tent yourself: be gone, beseech you.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Sir, I shall not be slack: in sign whereof, Please ye we may contrive this afternoon, And quaff carouses to our mistress' health, And do as adversaries do in law, Strive mightily, but eat and drink as friends.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: I will converse with iron-witted fools And unrespective boys: none are for me
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: How far is it, my lord, to Berkeley now?
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Thank, gentle uncle. Come, lords, away.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: What must be shall be.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Shall I go win my daughter to thy will?
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: So long as heaven and nature lengthens it.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Unfit to live or die: O gravel heart! After him, fellows; bring him to the block.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: What storm is this that blows so contrary? Is Romeo slaughter'd, and is Tybalt dead? My dear-loved cousin, and my dearer lord? Then, dreadful trumpet, sound the general doom! For who is living, if those two are gone?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Ay, madam, from the reach of these my hands: Would none but I might venge my cousin's death!
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Kind sister, thanks: we'll enter all together. And, in good time, here the lieutenant comes. Master lieutenant, pray you, by your leave, How doth the prince, and my young son of York?
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Come hither, Mariana. Say, wast thou e'er contracted to this woman?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Why, then let's home again. Come, sirrah, let's away.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: In faith, I will. Let me peruse this face. Mercutio's kinsman, noble County Paris! What said my man, when my betossed soul Did not attend him as we rode? I think
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: You have a daughter call'd Elizabeth, Virtuous and fair, royal and gracious.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Now welcome more, and ten times more beloved, Than if thou never hadst deserved our hate.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: I fear, too early: for my mind misgives Some consequence yet hanging in the stars Shall bitterly begin his fearful date With this night's revels and expire the term Of a despised life closed in my breast By some vile forfeit of untimely death. But He, that hath the steerage of my course, Direct my sail! On, lusty gentlemen.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: We know your drift: speak what?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Assay the power you have.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Too well, too well thou tell'st a tale so ill. Where is the Earl of Wiltshire? where is Bagot? What is become of Bushy? where is Green? That they have let the dangerous enemy Measure our confines with such peaceful steps? If we prevail, their heads shall pay for it: I warrant they have made peace with Bolingbroke.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: In bed asleep, while they do dream things true.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Bid them wash their faces And keep their teeth clean. So, here comes a brace. You know the cause, air, of my standing here.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Lords, give us leave: I'll try this widow's wit.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Say, you chose him More after our commandment than as guided By your own true affections, and that your minds, Preoccupied with what you rather must do Than what you should, made you against the grain To voice him consul: lay the fault on us.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: My gracious silence, hail! Wouldst thou have laugh'd had I come coffin'd home, That weep'st to see me triumph? Ay, my dear, Such eyes the widows in Corioli wear, And mothers that lack sons.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: My noble lords and cousins all, good morrow. I have been long a sleeper; but, I hope, My absence doth neglect no great designs, Which by my presence might have been concluded.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: There is differency between a grub and a butterfly; yet your butterfly was a grub. This Marcius is grown from man to dragon: he has wings; he's more than a creeping thing.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Thou detestable maw, thou womb of death, Gorged with the dearest morsel of the earth, Thus I enforce thy rotten jaws to open, And, in despite, I'll cram thee with more food!
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: And came I not at last to comfort you?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Thy life hath that dishonour'd.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: So part we sadly in this troublous world, To meet with joy in sweet Jerusalem.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: That would be ten days' wonder at the least.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: A goodly city is this Antium. City, 'Tis I that made thy widows: many an heir Of these fair edifices 'fore my wars Have I heard groan and drop: then know me not, Lest that thy wives with spits and boys with stones In puny battle slay me. Save you, sir.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: O, then, dear saint, let lips do what hands do; They pray, grant thou, lest faith turn to despair.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Born in Verona, old Antonio's son: My father dead, my fortune lives for me; And I do hope good days and long to see.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Art thou gone so? love, lord, ay, husband, friend! I must hear from thee every day in the hour,
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Stars, stars, And all eyes else dead coals! Fear thou no wife; I'll have no wife, Paulina.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: A pleasing cordial, princely Buckingham, is this thy vow unto my sickly heart. There wanteth now our brother Gloucester here, To make the perfect period of this peace.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Boldly, at least. But, O, poor souls, Come you to seek the lamb here of the fox? Good night to your redress! Is the duke gone? Then is your cause gone too. The duke's unjust, Thus to retort your manifest appeal, And put your trial in the villain's mouth Which here you come to accuse.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: He hath released him, Isabel, from the world: His head is off and sent to Angelo.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: 'Twere well We let the people know't.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: But now the blood of twenty thousand men Did triumph in my face, and they are fled; And, till so much blood thither come again, Have I not reason to look pale and dead? All souls that will be safe fly from my side, For time hath set a blot upon my pride.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Vouchsafe a word, young sister, but one word.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Farewell! I will omit no opportunity That may convey my greetings, love, to thee.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: A little joy enjoys the queen thereof; For I am she, and altogether joyless. I can no longer hold me patient. Hear me, you wrangling pirates, that fall out In sharing that which you have pill'd from me! Which of you trembles not that looks on me? If not, that, I being queen, you bow like subjects, Yet that, by you deposed, you quake like rebels? O gentle villain, do not turn away!
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Suppose, my lords, he did it unconstrain'd, Think you 'twere prejudicial to his crown?
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Well, sir, to do you courtesy, This will I do, and this I will advise you: First, tell me, have you ever been at Pisa?
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: What do ye talk? Have we not had a taste of his obedience? Our aediles smote? ourselves resisted? Come.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Do, Paulina; For this affliction has a taste as sweet As any cordial comfort. Still, methinks, There is an air comes from her: what fine chisel Could ever yet cut breath? Let no man mock me, For I will kiss her.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Then, window, let day in, and let life out.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: The gods be good unto us!
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Welcome, dear cousin, my thoughts' sovereign The weary way hath made you melancholy.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Come, Kate, we'll to bed. We three are married, but you two are sped. 'Twas I won the wager, though you hit the white; And, being a winner, God give you good night!
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Here's he that would take from you all your power.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: You have, my lord: would it might please your grace, At our entreaties, to amend that fault!
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: I will not seal your knowledge with showing them. I will make much of your voices, and so trouble you no further.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Go fetch them hither: if they deny to come.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Poor painted queen, vain flourish of my fortune! Why strew'st thou sugar on that bottled spider, Whose deadly web ensnareth thee about? Fool, fool! thou whet'st a knife to kill thyself. The time will come when thou shalt wish for me To help thee curse that poisonous bunchback'd toad.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Why, what wouldst thou do there before I go?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: It is extempore, from my mother-wit.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Silence that fellow: I would he had some cause To prattle for himself.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: In what enormity is Marcius poor in, that you two have not in abundance?
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Nay, I hear nothing: his mother and his wife Hear nothing from him.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: But thou didst kill my children.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Why, there thou hast it: two deep enemies, Foes to my rest and my sweet sleep's disturbers
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: How far off is our brother Montague? Where is the post that came from Montague?
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: I thought you had been willing to resign.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: All seeing heaven, what a world is this!
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: O, You have, I know, petition'd all the gods For my prosperity!
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: O thou well skill'd in curses, stay awhile, And teach me how to curse mine enemies!
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Oxford, how haps it, in this smooth discourse, You told not how Henry the Sixth hath lost All that which Henry Fifth had gotten? Methinks these peers of France should smile at that. But for the rest, you tell a pedigree Of threescore and two years; a silly time To make prescription for a kingdom's worth.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Why, how now, long-tongued Warwick! dare you speak? When you and I met at Saint Alban's last, Your legs did better service than your hands.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Nay, then indeed she cannot choose but hate thee, Having bought love with such a bloody spoil.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Thereon I pawn my credit and mine honour.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: This letter, then, to Friar Peter give;
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Seize on the shame-faced Henry, bear him hence; And once again proclaim us King of England.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: O, teach me how I should forget to think.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Are there no other tokens Between you 'greed concerning her observance?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Not mad, but bound more than a mad-man is; Shut up in prison, kept without my food, Whipp'd and tormented and--God-den, good fellow.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Think upon me! hang 'em! I would they would forget me, like the virtues Which our divines lose by 'em.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: When you are gentle, you shall have one too, And not till then.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: If I do so, it will be of more price, Being spoke behind your back, than to your face.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: O, wilt thou leave me so unsatisfied?
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: We'll part the time between's then; and in that I'll no gainsaying.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: The senate, Coriolanus, are well pleased To make thee consul.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Yea, and much better blood than his or thine.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: I am, as thy general is.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: This cheers my heart, to see your forwardness.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: So other foes may set upon our backs. Stand we in good array; for they no doubt
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: I'll bring him to you. Let me desire your company: he must come, Or what is worst will follow.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: This nor hurts him nor profits you a jot; Forbear it therefore; give your cause to heaven. Mark what I say, which you shall find
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Carlisle, this is your doom: Choose out some secret place, some reverend room, More than thou hast, and with it joy thy life; So as thou livest in peace, die free from strife: For though mine enemy thou hast ever been, High sparks of honour in thee have I seen.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: O, that thou wouldst as well afford a grave As thou canst yield a melancholy seat! Then would I hide my bones, not rest them here. O, who hath any cause to mourn but I?
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Aufidius, and you Volsces, mark; for we'll Hear nought from Rome in private. Your request?
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Therein thou wrong'st thy children mightily.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Sir, make me not your story.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Sir, you seem a sober ancient gentleman by your habit, but your words show you a madman. Why, sir, what 'cerns it you if I wear pearl and gold? I thank my good father, I am able to maintain it.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: I beseech your highness, do not marry me to a whore. Your highness said even now, I made you a duke: good my lord, do not recompense me in making me a cuckold.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Now, knock when I bid you, sirrah villain!
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: I hear that news, my lord.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Madam, I have a touch of your condition, Which cannot brook the accent of reproof.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Let them puff all about mine ears, present me Death on the wheel or at wild horses' heels, Or pile ten hills on the Tarpeian rock, That the precipitation might down stretch Below the beam of sight, yet will I still Be thus to them.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: I ne'er heard yet That any of these bolder vices wanted Less impudence to gainsay what they did Than to perform it first.
Speaker: LEONTES
